ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: users_identity_required_check

ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: guardians_contact_required_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'ACTIVE' and "ends_on" is null)
          or
          ("status" <> 'ACTIVE' and "ends_on" is not null)
        )
ddl.name: student_enrollments_status_end_date_check

ddl.value: "closed_at" is null or ("opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" >= "opened_at")
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_open_close_order_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("status" = 'PLANNED' and "opened_at" is null and "closed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'OPEN' and "opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" is null)
          or
          ("status" = 'CLOSED' and "opened_at" is not null and "closed_at" is not null)
          or
          ("status" = 'CANCELLED')
        )
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_status_timestamps_check

ddl.value: "card_result" <> 'MATCHED' or ("student_id" is not null and "card_id" is not null)
ddl.name: attendance_attempts_matched_card_identity_check

ddl.value:
(
          ("presence_state" = 'ON_CAMPUS' and "checked_out_at" is null and "departure_result" = 'NOT_RUN')
          or
          ("presence_state" = 'SIGNED_OUT' and "checked_out_at" is not null and "departure_result" <> 'NOT_RUN')
        )
ddl.name: student_attendance_records_presence_state_check

ddl.value:
"departure_result" <> 'EARLY' or (
          "check_out_verified_by_membership_id" is not null
          and "check_out_reason" is not null
          and length(trim("check_out_reason")) > 0
        )
ddl.name: student_attendance_records_early_departure_check

ddl.value:
"departure_result" <> 'EARLY' or (
          "actor_membership_id" is not null
          and "reason" is not null
          and length(trim("reason")) > 0
        )
ddl.name: student_presence_events_early_departure_actor_reason_check

ddl.value:
"status" <> 'ACTIVE' or (
          "provider_business_account_id" is not null
          and "provider_phone_number_id" is not null
          and "provider_connection_ref" is not null
          and "activated_at" is not null
        )
ddl.name: school_whatsapp_senders_active_provider_identity_check
